**What this changes**

**For a new or changed check**

- [ ] Spec or client-code reference in a comment
- [ ] Test with a mock server route (fail case and pass case)
- [ ] Network/RPC errors report `unknown`, never `fail`
- [ ] README check table updated

**Checks**

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`
